question:
Out of the five letter-clusters listed, four are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.

KP, MN, EV, FT, HS
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is: **1st letter and 2nd letters are opposite to each other.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9dde284a7f701ec6176eac2cce308d994dff7decbbe9e353bf70559b9bba1a8.png] 

Thus, **FT **is odd one.

Hence, the correct answer is "FT".
